phone calls and appointments.en: Hello, who's calling, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Alô, quem fala, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.en: Hello, it's Marta, is Juan there?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Oi, é a Marta, o Juan está?

phone calls and appointments.en: One moment, please.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Um momento, por favor.

phone calls and appointments.text: Lo siento, no está en casa.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, he's not at home.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Sinto muito, ele não está em casa.

phone calls and appointments.text: Quiero pedir una cita, por favor.
phone calls and appointments.en: I want to make an appointment, please.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Quero marcar um horário, por favor.

phone calls and appointments.en: Do you have an appointment free on Tuesday?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tem horário para terça?

phone calls and appointments.text: La cita es el jueves a las cinco.
phone calls and appointments.en: The appointment is on Thursday at five.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O horário é na quinta às cinco.

phone calls and appointments.en: What's your phone number?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Qual é o seu número de telefone?

phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call you this afternoon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te ligo hoje à tarde.

phone calls and appointments.en: Can you speak more slowly, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Pode falar mais devagar, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: No oigo bien, hay mucho ruido.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can't hear well, it's very noisy.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não estou ouvindo bem, está muito barulho.

phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling to change my appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando para mudar meu horário.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿El viernes por la mañana le va bien?
phone calls and appointments.en: Does Friday morning suit you?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Sexta de manhã está bom para o senhor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Perfecto, el viernes a las diez.
phone calls and appointments.en: Perfect, Friday at ten.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Perfeito, sexta às dez.

phone calls and appointments.en: My mobile is out of battery.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu celular está sem bateria.

phone calls and appointments.en: Can I leave a message?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Posso deixar um recado?

phone calls and appointments.text: Lo siento, aquí no vive ningún Pablo.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, there's no Pablo living here.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, aqui não mora nenhum Pablo.

phone calls and appointments.text: Tengo cita en la peluquería mañana.
phone calls and appointments.en: I have a hairdresser's appointment tomorrow.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tenho horário no cabeleireiro amanhã.

phone calls and appointments.en: Can you call me later, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você me liga depois, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Te mando un mensaje esta noche.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll send you a message tonight.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te mando uma mensagem hoje à noite.

phone calls and appointments.en: Am I speaking to Mrs García?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou falando com a senhora García, certo?

phone calls and appointments.en: Yes, speaking, go ahead.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Sim, sou eu, pode falar.

phone calls and appointments.text: El dentista no tiene citas hasta junio.
phone calls and appointments.en: The dentist has no appointments until June.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O dentista não tem horário até junho.

phone calls and appointments.en: Call me after eight.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me liga depois das oito.

phone calls and appointments.en: What time is your appointment?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A que horas é a sua consulta?

phone calls and appointments.text: No puedo ir el lunes, lo siento.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can't go on Monday, sorry.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não posso ir na segunda, desculpe.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi número termina en cuarenta y cinco.
phone calls and appointments.en: My number ends in forty-five.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu número termina em quarenta e cinco.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ahora no puedo hablar, estoy en clase.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can't talk now, I'm in class.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Agora não posso falar, estou na aula.

phone calls and appointments.en: Shall we meet on Saturday at six?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vamos nos encontrar no sábado às seis?

phone calls and appointments.text: Vale, nos vemos en la plaza.
phone calls and appointments.en: OK, see you in the square.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Combinado, a gente se vê na praça.

phone calls and appointments.en: The line is busy.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A linha está ocupada.

phone calls and appointments.en: Can you hear me now?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Está me ouvindo bem agora?

phone calls and appointments.text: Necesito cancelar la reserva de mañana.
phone calls and appointments.en: I need to cancel tomorrow's booking.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Preciso cancelar a reserva de amanhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi agenda está llena esta semana.
phone calls and appointments.en: My diary is full this week.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha agenda está cheia esta semana.

phone calls and appointments.en: I'll put my brother on.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou passar para o meu irmão.

phone calls and appointments.en: Shall I call back later?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ligo de novo mais tarde?

phone calls and appointments.text: El médico tiene consulta los miércoles.
phone calls and appointments.en: The doctor sees patients on Wednesdays.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O médico atende às quartas.

phone calls and appointments.en: Thanks for calling, bye.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Obrigado por ligar, tchau.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi cita con el abogado es hoy.
phone calls and appointments.en: My appointment with the lawyer is today.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha consulta com o advogado é hoje.

phone calls and appointments.text: Hay un mensaje para ti en el contestador.
phone calls and appointments.en: There's a message for you on the answering machine.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tem um recado para você na secretária eletrônica.
